scope: Only thermal_gelation is merged in the primary branch. No estimator or numeric imputer has been fitted here.
encoding: Keep recovered per-fit training-only OneHotEncoder behaviour. Shared raw vocabulary/order does not require identical fitted one-hot dimensions across different targets/folds. Do not fit vocabulary on Test/case.

modulus_value_kPa.definition: Recorded mechanical modulus, converted to kPa; includes storage, compressive and other reported modulus types.

pore_size_um.definition: Characteristic hydrogel pore size, as reported or digitised from the source.

culture_or_exposure_duration_h.definition: Recorded duration of culture or material exposure; distinct from material preparation or prior LPS priming.

not_changed: All target values, record membership, other feature cells, splits and folds. Existing categorical-missing sentinels differ across historical target pipelines, but current categorical data contain no blanks; do not introduce a separate unlogged change.
alias_applicability_scope: Apply the thermal-to-physical merge to the documented P05 C-only records and the C4 HPA case in this package. For future materials, confirm non-covalent physical gelation; heating-induced covalent chemistry is not automatically physical self-assembly.
